leadText:
This is the 10th chapter of the Pokémon Mezastar: Aim to Be a Tag Master! manga. It was first published in the September 2022 issue of CoroCoro Ichiban!, released on July 21, 2022. It is 18 pages long.

It was made available on Weekly CoroCoro Comics on November 27, 2023.
